title: confiture test-db ram-setup --format json
description: The (re)creation of a tmpfs-backed tablespace for RAM clones (RamSetupResult.to_dict, plus action_command). When confiture lacks the OS rights to hand the LOCATION directory to the server's user, nothing in the catalog is touched: action_required is true, action_command names the privileged step, and the command exits 5. A refusal (a location outside the tmpfs allowlist, a non-managed database in the tablespace without --force) writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

owner.description: The OS user the PostgreSQL server runs as, who owns LOCATION (--owner).

recreated.description: True when an existing tablespace was dropped and re-created (the post-reboot reset); false on a first creation, and when action_required.

action_required.description: True when LOCATION could not be prepared, so nothing was created: run action_command, then re-run.

dropped_databases.description: The databases dropped from the tablespace before it was re-created (listed because dropping them is destructive); empty if none.

action_command.description: The privileged command that prepares LOCATION (`sudo install -d -o <owner> -g <owner> -m 700 <location>`). Present exactly when action_required is true.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
